0x000846.en: 「With the strength I have now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00093F.en: 「Dammit!@ Next time you won't get me!」

0x0009B9.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000AA0.en: 「Well now...@　how uncool of me, sheesh!」

0x000BA4.en: 「Like hell I'll fail here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BF8.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000D49.en: 「So this is it... the rest is on you.」

0x000D7B.en: 「Dammit...!@ Is this as far as I go!?」

0x000DF5.en: 「No good, too much damage... I'm retreating!」

0x000E42.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. The rest is up to you.」

0x000E80.en: 「Eek! The rest is in your hands!」

0x000EC7.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F72.en: 「Ugh... so I'm the one who falls like a meteor... I'm ejecting!」

0x00106A.en: 「Oh dear me, I've gone and got myself done in!」

0x0010AE.en: 「Ugh...ngh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001162.en: 「I'm sorry. I leave the rest to you.」

0x001197.en: 「Damn! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001254.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x001283.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0012D1.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00138C.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0013BB.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013F9.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001428.en: 「I can't go on. Allow me to take my leave.」

0x0014B3.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001619.en: 「Ejecting now...@ Ngh...! Not exactly a graceful exit...」

0x001846.en: 「So I'm still too green as well...!」

0x0018A7.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandoning ship takes top priority...!!」

0x0018E9.en: 「No good, they got me after all.」

0x0019C2.en: 「...Against the Unknown in the Arctic, the@ <Earth Federation Army>'s North American, Nordic,@ and Far East forces mount a joint op.」

0x001A54.en: 「And we, the Gaia Sabers,@ have been assigned to take part in it.」

0x001AB3.en: 「Air Christmas and Alpha Saber,@ enter the Beaufort Sea via the Bering Strait.」

0x001B50.en: 「Albero Est... Gamma Saber,@ enter the Arctic Ocean from the Greenland Sea@ together with the Iguazu.」

0x001C13.en: 「That's all the force we're committing?@ Are Omega and Beta still out of contact as usual?」

0x001CC7.en: (Omega...?@ So there were still other Sabers besides us.)

0x001D2A.en: 「Commander Alteur... will Delta Saber's Jinrai@ keep pursuing the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ correct?」

0x001DD2.en: 「No. Delta Saber is to stand by@ aboard the Grand Christmas.」

0x001E31.en: 「With respect, Commander...@ if this is due to concerns about the last outcome,@ that was...」

0x001EAF.en: 「What we must prioritize now@ is eliminating the outside threat and reclaiming the sunlight.」

0x001EFF.en: 「If we deliver results in this operation - the one@ the public is watching closest - doubts about our@ reason for being will fade.」

0x001FAA.en: 「Even if we couldn't protect the President,@ we have to prove we can protect the Earth.」

0x002040.en: 「Hmph... So getting a head start is fair game, then?」

0x002089.en: 「That's what Canis and Air Christmas are for.@ Show them what you can do.」

0x002104.en: 「Commander, if we make contact with the@ Steel Dragon Squadron en route to the Arctic,@ how should we respond?」

0x00219A.en: 「Attempt to seize them.@ Prioritize the Re-Technologist machines above all.@ They may be of use against the Unknown.」

0x002239.en: 「If you judge seizure impossible,@ or that it would hinder the Arctic operation,@ don't press the pursuit. Wait for another chance.」

0x0022EA.en: 「...Personally, I'd rather have a go at those@ people than the Unknown.」

0x002355.en: 「My Jinrai, too, was meant to bring down@ the Double G to begin with...」

0x0023A5.en: 「I'm aware that each of you holds some manner@ of grudge against the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ but...」

0x002429.en: 「With an eye to what comes later,@ I want their machines taken as intact as possible.」

0x002482.en: 「Does that include the machines from the@ Zentr Project as well?」

0x0024F6.en: 「On that matter, follow Dr. Zapad's instructions.」

0x002539.en: (...He's placed in that man an awful lot of trust.@ Or is he simply being used?)

0x0025B0.en: (Either way,@ it's only a matter of time before Hugo learns the truth...)

0x00260C.en: 「Then Air Christmas, Alpha Saber,@ and Gamma Saber are to sortie once ready.@ That is all.」

0x002708.en: 「Yeah. I'm getting off the Hiryu.@ It's decided. I'm going to petition Colonel Lefina@ and Major Gilliam right now.」

0x0027A7.en: 「Not even a word of discussion - just deciding this on your own!@ This isn't just your problem!」

0x002809.en: 「No, it's mine alone. You stay here.」

0x002849.en: 「Wh-why?!@ Are you saying I'd just be dead weight?!」

0x002899.en: 「You've realized it too, haven't you?@ Mitarl Zapad and I have a long, dark history.@ I can't drag you into that.」

0x00295D.en: 「Listen, Aqua...@ you should leave the Zentr Project.@ Lean on your father and you'll manage, right?」

0x002A24.en: 「Yeah. Senator Taylor Centrum... and Centrum Express.@ I figured it was just a shared name,@ but you're the real deal, milady.」

0x002AF3.en: 「...Their daughter's one of the rebels.@ Father and the rest must be in a real uproar by now.」

0x002B4C.en: 「Anyway, there's no need to stick with me any further.@ Understood?」

0x002C1A.en: 「Yes. The Melior Esse called Glacies@ seemed to be wary of Josh.」

0x002CB6.en: 「...I can't really say.@ All I did was hear Glacies' voice@ through Sympatia.」

0x002D46.en: 「Even so, there's no doubt your machine@ is a valuable lead.」

0x002DAB.en: 「Which brings me to it, Colonel Lefina...@ there's something I'd like to propose.」

0x002E1A.en: 「To gather intel on the Ruina and dimensional rift,@ I think we should get Vice Admiral Jacob's approval@ to head to the Arctic too.」

0x002EEA.en: 「You were prepared to head to the Arctic@ all on your own, weren't you?@ Ensign Excellen was worried about you.」

0x002F8A.en: 「This is no longer your problem alone.@ Besides, Sympatia could be the key@ to unlocking the mystery of the Ruina...」

0x003023.en: 「And perhaps the dimensional rift as well.@ That's what you think, isn't it?」

0x003088.en: 「Even now, the Earth is being eaten away with each passing moment.@ If there's even a slim chance of stopping it,@ I say we take the gamble.」

0x003154.en: 「Josh...@ Once again, will you help us?」

0x0031B0.en: 「Ah, no... if anything, this is something I@ should be asking of you.@ I'm sorry for making you go out of your way.」

0x003255.en: 「Then, after disembarking the civilians in Mexico,@ we head for the Arctic Ocean.」

0x0032B4.en: 「Major Gilliam, can you obtain data on the@ Federation and Gaia Sabers' Arctic entry routes?」

0x00337B.en: 「Still, this ship really is huge.@ Wander into another block and I'd get lost.」

0x0033F2.en: 「Well, sure. It's big enough to hold a few@ super robots like the Compatible Kaiser.」

0x003472.en: 「But for all its size, the crew seems@ pretty small in number...」

0x0034C8.en: 「A lot of it's automated.@ Far fewer hands aboard than on a carrier.」

0x00353C.en: 「...If you'd spar with me, Major Sanger,@ I'd really put my heart into it.」

0x0035A4.en: 「Indeed.@ It's precisely at times like these that one must not neglect training.」

0x0035FD.en: 「...That man is the pilot of the DyGenGuard?」

0x003640.en: 「Yeah. That's the boss, Major Sanger Zonvolt.」

0x0036BB.en: 「I'm Touma Kanou.@ You saved me twice, Major.@ Let me thank you for that.」

0x003751.en: 「You're... one of the civilians from Komodin Island?」

0x003792.en: 「You said twice. There was another time?」

0x0037C3.en: 「During the Shura conflict, Touma got captured@ by the Shura general Magnus in Hakodate.」

0x003853.en: (That's right... maybe this is fate too...)

0x003896.en: 「I see... so that's how it was...」

0x0038E3.en: 「Do Ensign Aqua and the others know?」

0x003923.en: 「No...@ though I've explained things to Major Kai.」

0x003970.en: 「Judging from the fact that a transmitter was@ planted in the TE Absorber...」

0x0039D5.en: 「Mitarl Zapad is scheming something - using not just@ himself, but the Special Tactics Instructor Corps@ and the Steel Dragon Squadron too.」

0x003A8C.en: 「All the more so if the Gaia Sabers are behind@ that man. And with luck, I might grasp a thread@ that leads to the truth.」

0x003B46.en: 「But the other side must be anticipating your@ move. It's extremely dangerous.」

0x003BA5.en: 「I know.@ That's why I want to act separately,@ so no harm comes to the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x003C32.en: 「Given the situation we're in,@ losing your fighting strength@ is far from what I'd wish for, but...」

0x003CCE.en: 「If those are the circumstances, there's no other choice.@ I grant you permission to disembark.」

0x003D2A.en: 「...My subordinates are also conducting their own inquiry@ into the Zentr Project. I'll have them support you.@ I'll designate a rendezvous point later.」

0x003E21.en: 「To avoid any needless misunderstanding, I'll tell@ the others you're on a mission connected to@ Major Gilliam, but...」

0x003EC0.en: 「Are you certain you don't want to tell@ Ensign Aqua the truth?」

0x003F16.en: 「Yes.@　Being used by Mitarl is a burden I'll bear alone.」

0x003F6C.en: 「Hugo. I hear you're leaving the Hiryu.」

0x003FE0.en: 「I know that.@　If you had something to hide, you'd just@　slip off without a word.」

0x00407C.en: 「Does this have to do with that transmitter?」

0x0040FA.en: 「It's not as serious as what you're carrying.@ It may still be my problem alone, for now.」

0x004187.en: 「...Joshua, don't dwell on it too much.@ Don't... become like me.」

0x00423F.en: 「That getup... what are you playing at?」

0x004273.en: 「Isn't it obvious?@　I'm boarding the TE Absorber too.」

0x0042C9.en: 「I told you there's no need to come along.」

0x004306.en: 「I want to know the truth of this project too.@　Besides, if we run into the enemy on the way,@　who's going to handle the DFC?」

0x0043A2.en: 「At least until we make contact with Major@　Gilliam's staff, I'm coming with you.」

0x004489.en: 「Maintain strict anti-air watch.@　Submerge the instant Lt. Hugo's team launches.」

0x0044EC.en: 「ESM contact!@　Multiple high-heat sources, bearing two o'clock!」

0x00455E.en: 「Of all things, their flagship...!@　Your orders, Captain?」

0x0045BA.en: 「We'll watch their next move. Since they didn't land@　a decisive blow at the outset, I'd say their aim to seize@　our machines is still very much alive.」

0x00468C.en: 「But they won't hesitate to use force.@　For now, the moral high ground is theirs.」

0x00470F.en: 「Understood. All hands, maintain Condition One.@ Hold TD at current position. Calculate an@ egress course. Prep overboost, high-speed cruise.」

0x0047E1.en: 「After launch, each unit, secure our accel space.@ But no attacking until ordered.」

0x004852.en: 「Breaking from this zone is top priority, then.@　A wise decision.」

0x0048A8.en: （Damn the Gaia Sabers, showing up@　at a time like this...!）

0x004929.en: （Is this... a sign I shouldn't go?）

0x004988.en: （Ing...@　And Bronzo 28's lot don't seem to be here...）

0x0049E1.en: （Sanger Zonvolt...@　I've been waiting for the day we'd meet again.）

0x004A43.en: 「I told the commander it was a long shot,@　but to make contact this easily...」

0x004AD0.en: 「Alpha 1, I'll hail the Hiryu.@　No attacking until I give the word.」

0x004B3B.en: 「Conserving strength?@　Useless, so long as you and I are here.」

0x004BCE.en: 「Hmph... no point hiding who we are@　from them anymore.」

0x004C24.en: 「Captain, incoming signal from the Air Christmas!」

0x004C77.en: 「...To the Steel Dragon flagship Hiryu Kai.@　I am the captain of the Gaia Sabers flagship@　Air Christmas, Colonel Carly Nauman.」

0x004D47.en: 「Th-that's Lt. Colonel Lee Linjun, isn't it!?」

0x004DEF.en: 「He captained the Shirogane... but defected from@　the Federation to the Shadow Mirror and Inspectors.」

0x004E81.en: 「Wh-why the hell is a guy like that@　with the Gaia Sabers!?」

0x004ED7.en: 「Captain Lefina will press him on that,@　I'm sure.」

0x004F2D.en: 「...You have been designated rebels against the@　<Earth Federation Government>, with attack authorized.」

0x004FAC.en: 「Disarm and surrender at once.@　Refuse, and we begin our attack.」

0x00501A.en: 「Isn't the highest priority right now the@　dimensional rift enveloping Earth, and the@　Ruina repeating their indiscriminate slaughter?」

0x0050DA.en: 「Don't change the subject.@　You are criminals who assassinated the president.」

0x005139.en: 「Then let me ask you.@　Why did you launch the president's craft back then?」

0x0051B1.en: 「An Urchin appeared on the Hagane's course.@　No, before that... if you meant to evacuate the@　president, why not do it far sooner?」

0x005280.en: 「Had you meekly accepted Commander Alteur's@　orders, none of that would have happened.」

0x005306.en: 「The GS's current authority does not extend to@　issuing commands to the Federation forces.」

0x00536B.en: 「So we stated we'd go through proper channels,@　answer for our conduct in the proper venue,@　and asked to explain directly to the president.」

0x005422.en: 「Yet though the president was right there,@　Commander Alteur refused it.」

0x0054A2.en: 「...Let me ask in return. Had the president@　given the order himself, would you have obeyed?」

0x005510.en: 「If it were legitimate. But you opened fire@　unilaterally, even with an emergency@　unfolding at the South Pole.」

0x0055DD.en: 「Wasn't Commander Alteur's true aim to assassinate@　the president... and then frame us@　as the culprits?」

0x00568E.en: 「...You'd call that a plot on our side?@　Baseless slander.」

0x0056EA.en: 「Is it? The fleet's formation back then@　could well have been arranged to deliberately@　drive us in a certain direction.」

0x005786.en: 「And an Urchin appeared right in our path...@　If it was the Guests' trump card, why send in@　only a machine meant for armed reconnaissance?」

0x005846.en: 「You mean to say we staged that too?」

0x00588C.en: 「Urchins have appeared since around the@　<DC War>. Capturing and fielding one is possible.」

0x00590E.en: 「What you're saying isn't even circumstantial.@　Pure speculation. You can spin any tale you like.」

0x00598E.en: 「Then one could say people simply believe the@　tale you fabricated and made public.」

0x0059FF.en: 「Sophistry.@　That you killed the president@　is an undeniable fact.」

0x005A6B.en: 「...Yes, we were made to dance.@　But there's much else@　suspicious about the Gaia Sabers...」

0x005AF8.en: 「Are you truly a sword to guard Earth's sphere?@　Or are you power-usurpers wearing a guardian's mask?」

0x005B93.en: 「We'll bring the truth to light in the proper venue.@　Even if we bear the rebel's stigma for now.」

0x005C16.en: 「And after that,@　we'll accept judgment for the crimes we've committed.」

0x005C6C.en: 「Quite the confidence. We're the ones demanding@ your surrender, to keep our losses down, you know...」

0x005CE0.en: 「...Any more of this is a waste of time.」

0x005D11.en: 「I knew it, they mean to fight!」

0x005D6A.en: 「Same as you, I've got a score to settle with them.@　I've been waiting for a chance like this.」

0x005E09.en: 「We'll settle things with the Steel Dragons sooner@　or later. Thinning their forces here won't draw@　any complaints from Alteur.」

0x005EB4.en: 「Especially once we've got the Re-Tech machine.」

0x005F10.en: 「Then why didn't you let them pass?@　You could've just headed straight for the North Pole.」

0x005F93.en: 「Well, I understand how you feel.@　Just say I acted on my own.」

0x00602C.en: 「I'm Egretta Uno.@　Maybe it's easier for you if I go by@　Egret Urd.」

0x00611C.en: 「That's right.@　Though I nearly slept forever in the depths of the earth.」

0x006175.en: 「...So there was more than one con artist here.」

0x0061C1.en: 「Lee, and now you... the ones we've been fighting@　are Earth's guardians!?@　Talk about false advertising!」

0x00627C.en: 「The Gaia Sabers...@　Even shadier than Ariel let on...」

0x0062E4.en: 「Revealing yourself was a mistake.@　Make this public and the Gaia Sabers will...」

0x006361.en: 「Will what? We're the ones in power now...@　and in a situation like this, people lend their ears@　to a guardian's words, not a criminal's excuses.」

0x00642D.en: 「But if we expose what you've done in the past!」

0x006470.en: 「Heh, the past can be spun any way.@ Some of you once belonged to the <DC>@ or <Colony Integration Force>, against the Federation.」

0x006537.en: 「Such people now play at being Earth's guardians.@　Why? Because they got results and became victors.」

0x0065BD.en: 「So we purge the rebels, drive out the invaders,@　and protect Earth's sphere.」

0x006625.en: 「And then, none behind this mask will doubt...@　or rather, doubt would be meaningless anyway.」

0x0066CD.en: 「The tables have turned. We'll guard the peace@　of Earth's sphere in your place.」

0x006763.en: 「Right you are.@ The Machinery Children - and the humans who crushed@ the body and pride of me, their creator...」

0x006805.en: 「Sanger Zonvolt above all.@　How many times, inside the Moderator, did I dream@　of you writhing in agony and dying.」

0x0068A1.en: 「Then return to the depths of the earth,@　and go on dreaming that dream.」

0x006931.en: 「XO, time until we clear the combat zone?」

0x00698A.en: 「Then relay to all units.@ We break from this zone in five minutes.@ Escort the ship and secure accel space, top priority.」

0x006A54.en: 「Permitted. They fired the first shot...@　and even if we don't fire back, that fact@　will surely be twisted anyway.」

0x006AF3.en: 「Alpha 1 to all units.@　Machines designated as Re-Tech, don't destroy them,@　capture them. The rest you may crush.」

0x006C19.en: (...Contact with Mitarl could push@ the Steel Dragons into an even worse spot.@ The medicine... I'll stretch it as far as it'll go)

0x006D1A.en: 「Even if we're dancing in Mitarl's palm,@　we can't afford any more missteps.」

0x006D91.en: 「Understood. My patience for the Gaia Sabers@　has run dry too.」

0x006DFC.en: 「I cut you down back then@　at the <Earth Cradle>」

0x006E4E.en: 「Yes, and regenerating cost me a great deal of time.@　The utmost humiliation.」

0x006EBC.en: 「This time it's your turn to be cut down.@　Die miserably, as a rebel!」

0x006F27.en: 「Lee Linjun...@　What face do you wear, riding on that ship?」

0x006F86.en: 「The soft Federation can't be an ideal army.@　With the Shadow Mirror gone, the Gaia Sabers are...」

0x00700F.en: 「The sword of the supreme power - that is my ideal army.@　To repay Commander Alteur, who took me in,@　I swallow my shame and stand here.」

0x0070BA.en: 「The Gaia Sabers, an ideal army?@　They look like nothing but a pack of con men.」

0x00711F.en: 「The Machinery Children boy, and now you...@　Quite the reunion of familiar faces.@　Not that it makes me happy.」

0x0071BB.en: 「Excellen Browning...@　That absurd attitude of yours never changes.」

0x00721D.en: 「I'm sure there were all sorts of circumstances,@　but what's with the name Carly?@　It's a dead giveaway, you know.」

0x0072BC.en: 「Maybe you should've put on a mask@　too, hm?」

0x007309.en: 「Silence.@　You are traitors, criminals who killed the president.@　Know your place.」

0x00737E.en: 「...The president ending up like that@　does us no good at all, you know.」

0x0073FB.en: 「You cooked it up in the confusion, but...@　your boss's scheme will come out eventually.」

0x007478.en: 「The nerve of you, sitting there@　so shamelessly!」

0x0074DA.en: 「For a great cause, I'll bear even living in disgrace.」

0x007523.en: 「A cause, after framing us and the president!?@　You're worse than the Guests, the lot of you!」

0x0075A6.en: 「So that machine holds the key to their mystery.」

0x0075EC.en: 「That guy... that movement, what's he up to!?」

0x00762F.en: 「The Re-Tech machine.@　Strip its combat ability and capture it.」

0x0076BF.en: （Back when we Cry Wolves went to the@　<Earth Cradle>...@　was he already being carried out of there?）

0x00775D.en: （Could it be... I had a hand in it@　without knowing...?）

0x0077DB.en: 「Retreat order to all units!@　Deploying EA, we break from this zone!」

0x007837.en: 「Dragon 2 to all units!@　The ship is about to leave this zone!@　Nearest and slow units, latch onto the ship!」

0x0078D3.en: 「All other units, break away on your own!」

0x0079B4.en: 「Alpha 1, no need to chase them.@　We return to our original mission.」

0x007A13.en: 「Well, fine. That order... I'll heed it.」

0x007A56.en: 「To think Lt. Col. Lee and Egret Urd are alive@　and with the Gaia Sabers, of all things.」

0x007ADC.en: 「Huh? Lt. Col. Lee? What do you mean?」

0x007B19.en: 「Captain, don't tell me... you didn't notice?」

0x007B59.en: 「The Air Christmas's captain, Colonel Carly Nauman,@　is one and the same as Lt. Col. Lee Linjun.」

0x007C10.en: 「They're probably wondering right now@　why they got passed over.」

0x007C69.en: 「In any case, we've got even more questions about@ the Gaia Sabers. Why would Alteur recruit@ people bound to face Federation scrutiny...?」

0x007D32.en: 「A false name or a mask can't hide@　their entire past, and yet...」

0x007DA4.en: 「If they're the president's men, they could bury@　old scandals easy - with power like that.」

0x007E0C.en: 「No... to those who question the Gaia Sabers'@　existence, they're perfect material for@　challenging how the organization is run.」

0x007EAE.en: 「Then maybe they picked them on merit.@　Fewer skeletons to worry about, and if 'winner takes@　all' holds, plenty of folks would sign on.」

0x007F65.en: 「Even so, I'd think they'll face@　political scrutiny down the line...」

0x007FCA.en: 「How do I put it... doesn't it seem like they@　deliberately leave openings and just let them sit?」

0x008066.en: 「To crush the people who point them out.@　And use them as stepping stones, too.」

0x0080C5.en: 「So they frame criminals and make a name for@　themselves by striking them down.」

0x008133.en: 「Hmph...@　If it were me, I'd just pick a fight the simple way.@　No need to put on some big production like that.」

0x0081C0.en: 「Right? It almost looks like@　they're blowing this up on purpose.」

0x00821F.en: 「In any case, we'll approach the coast again,@　drop off the civilians, then head for the Arctic.」

0x0082B5.en: 「...Colonel Lefina.@　There's something I'd like to discuss, if I may.」

0x00831A.en: 「Of course. Let's take it to my quarters.」

0x008398.en: 「Yes... I've judged that making contact with@　Mitarl right now would be too dangerous.」

0x008415.en: 「I suppose so... Some in the Gaia Sabers,@ like Egretta, view us as open enemies.」

0x0084B4.en: 「Even if I'm dancing in Mitarl's palm,@ I can't afford a misstep - at least not until@ we see a way to break the dimensional rift.」

0x0085AB.en: 「I'll make it hold together.@　I've no intention of letting it end here.」

0x008635.en: 「Yes. There's something I wanted to tell you...」

0x008675.en: 「...Aqua, your SL level for piloting and@　combat with the TE Absorber - what is it now?」

0x008770.en: 「The fighting's only going to get worse...@　You may end up fighting in the TE Absorber too.@　This is to prepare for that.」

0x008852.en: 「So... what was it you wanted to tell me?」

0x00888F.en: 「...No, never mind. It can wait.@　Let's get to the simulator training.」

0x0088FE.en: （I have to finish this thing fast...@　It's like I'm carrying a time bomb inside me.）
